description: Returns the activity log, newest first: who published, rolled back, changed people, domains, settings or protection, exported or read visitor data, connected AI apps or changed billing, where and when. No workspace: the person's own account (paid plans). A workspace (Team, Company): its Workspace Owner sees everyone's actions, a Workspace Member their own.

workspace.description: Workspace id or name; leave out for the person's own account

name: get_activity
title: Read the activity log
